items.question: The Kenyan constitution was promulgated in the year?
The first African to become President of Kenya was?
The 'Mau Mau' uprising took place during which period?
Which document governs the conduct of citizens and the state?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. State three functions of the Kenyan constitution. (3 marks)
2. Name the three arms of government and state the role of each. (6 marks)
3. State two contributions of trade unions to the struggle for independence. (2 marks)
4. Name two national philosophies of Kenya. (2 marks)
5. Explain the importance of national unity. (3 marks)
